mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_language_stat ( user_id, language, submission_count, accepted_count, create_by ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{language}, 1, #{acceptedIncrement}, 'system' ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE submission_count = submission_count + 1, accepted_count = accepted_count + #{acceptedIncrement}, update_by = 'system', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
